comment: Material of A-4 (doc/megaliths/A4_CANYON_ARCH.md). Generated by tools/blender/megalith_a4_canyon_arch.py; the maps are final, the knobs are what made them (the painted materials arch_paint_* stay in the blend).
projection: the mesh's own UVs: one smart-UV atlas for the whole chain; the detail tile triplanar in object metres

basecolor.what: grey-blue masonry patches, hatching, streaks, orange bloom, sand at the foot, warm lights; no AO in it; true albedo

surface.what: R = baked AO, G = roughness, B = metallic (0)

detail.what: small masonry multiplied over the atlas colour x2 (stored at half), sampled triplanar in object metres, one tile per tile_m
